correctness.rationale: Every binary word uniquely specifies m_j ones in each of a+1 zero gaps. Counting positional pairs/triples gives t=Σjm_j, T=Σj(a-j)m_j. The x_i bounded-partition bijection yields T=at-Σx_i². Strict smoothing yields the unique all-nearly-equal minimizer of squared sum; strict transfer to extremes yields the unique maximizer, including remainder-zero boundaries. Formal geometric-product expansion gives the complete spectrum exactly. Parity follows x²≡x mod 2. Programs check 12,854 words/833 fibers and independent 100-parameter product expansions/3,125 fibers. Finite checks corroborate but are not the proof.

value.rationale: A complete two-binomial fiber is the natural observation class in subsequence reconstruction. The exact three-letter positional statistic is not determined by such data. The result gives a full all-parameter joint weighted enumerator and uniquely realized sharp extrema, including arbitrarily unbounded three-deck ambiguity among pairs sharing all length≤2 counts. This is an exact structural refinement, not an arbitrary small numerical instance or an unmotivated optimization.
